description: E7 with OpenAI commercial models via API: gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-luna (Responses API, where tool calling for these models is served; no temperature; reasoning effort low, the lowest accepted by both; max_output_tokens 4096, which includes reasoning), with 4 and 8 agents. Same design as E7c. Only the model call leaves the host. The token usage reported by the API (including reasoning tokens) is recorded per agent.
